title: 第25章降服唐三和戴沐白，为竹清解除婚约

第25章降服唐三和戴沐白，为竹清解除婚约-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》

“啊？”

“让，让我用嘴巴给他喂？”

“赵老师，这可是我的初吻啊。”

“要不，还是你来吧，我做不到。”

奥斯卡听到赵无极的要求，有点懵了，将所有恢复大香肠都递给他了。

赵无极闻言，又将眸光转移到其他人的身上。

“赵老师，你别看我。”

“我巴不得他现在就死了。”

“这种只会背地里偷袭的小人，不配活着。”

朱竹清注意到了赵无极的眸光，双手抱胸，眼中满是无情。

“小舞，你跟唐三最熟，你来吧。”

赵无极看了一眼宁荣荣，又看了一眼马红俊，只能将期望放在小舞身上。

两人是好朋友，这点忙应该可以帮。

小舞抿了抿嘴，看了一眼冷漠相视的叶寒，拒绝道：“赵老师，实在抱歉。”

如果换做是之前，小舞早就这么做了。

但是现在，她要顾及叶寒的心情。

而且唐三刚才做的确实太过分了，已经不是她之前认识的那个善良、诚实、贴心、有耐心的小三了。

“艹，胖子你来！”

赵无极见小舞拒绝了，也不好强迫她，只能将最后的期望放在马红俊的身上。

若是连他也拒绝了，就只能是他了。

不！

不能让马红俊拒绝。

必须让他执行。

“啊？”

“赵老师，我不想，我害羞！”

马红俊就知道会这样，当即发表他的抗拒。

“不想也不行。”

“你的初吻早就没了，装什么装。”

“若是你不同意，小心我揍你！”

赵无极怒目而视，给马红俊直接下不容违背的死命令。

就在马红俊在赵无极的压迫下，准备妥协之际，被吓怕的戴沐白站了出来，“赵老师，此事因我而起，还是我来吧。”

赵无极见戴沐白醒悟了，还知道弥补，深感欣慰。

戴沐白现在能站出来，就说明他还有良心，还有点担当。

“好，给你！”

“不要让我和院长失望。”

“人做错了，没事，但要知错能改。”

赵无极将恢复大香肠交给戴沐白，郑重地拍了拍他的肩膀。

“嗯，谢谢赵老师！”

戴沐白点了点头，走到唐三的面前，将恢复大香肠嚼碎，亲口喂给唐三。

在恢复大香肠的作用下，唐三身上的水肿情况以肉眼可见的速度消失。

宁风致和剑斗罗看到这一幕，微微一惊。

世人皆知，魂技的效果跟武魂的品质有明显的相关性。

奥斯卡的第一魂技都有这么好的效果，可见他的武魂品质到底有多高。

宁风致为了了解更加详细的信息，面带柔和的笑容，问道：“奥斯卡，你现在多大？魂力等级是多少？”

奥斯卡听到问话，尴尬地摸了摸头，回道：“回宁宗主，我十四岁了，魂力等级才二十九，跟大家相比，确实有点慢了。”

轰！

宁风致和剑斗罗闻言，脑海中一阵轰鸣。

十四岁的食物系魂师，魂力等级竟然达到了二十九级。

这是多么恐怖的天赋啊。

在他们的潜意识中，食物系魂师能在十五岁之前，把魂力等级提升到二十级，就已经算是天才了。

而奥斯卡展现出来的资质，已经是绝世天才，怪物中的怪物了。

“宁宗主，剑前辈，你们不知道。”

“其实，小奥是斗罗大陆历史上第一位先天满魂力十级的食物系魂师。”

“同样的，他也是斗罗大陆有史以来最有希望成为食物系封号斗罗的超级天才。”

弗兰德向宁风致介绍奥斯卡的情况，眼神中满是骄傲之色。

“嘶......”

宁风致和剑斗罗闻言，倒吸了口凉气。

先天满魂力十级的食物系魂师，听都没听过。

"Huh?"

"Let me feed him with my mouth?"

"Teacher Zhao, this is my first kiss."

"How about you do it? I can't do it."

When Oscar heard Zhao Wuji's request, he was a little confused and handed him all the recovery sausages.

Upon hearing this, Zhao Wuji turned his eyes to the others.

"Teacher Zhao, don't look at me."

"I wish he were dead right now."

"This kind of villain who can only attack behind the scenes doesn't deserve to live."

Zhu Zhuqing noticed Zhao Wuji's eyes, crossed his arms, his eyes full of ruthlessness.

"Xiao Wu, you know Tang San best, come on."

Zhao Wuji glanced at Ning Rongrong and then at Ma Hongjun, and could only place his hopes on Xiao Wu.

The two are good friends, so this little favor should help.

Xiao Wu pursed her lips, glanced at Ye Han who looked at him coldly, and refused: "Teacher Zhao, I'm really sorry."

If it had been before, Xiao Wu would have done this long ago.

But now, she has to take Ye Han's mood into consideration.

Moreover, what Tang San did just now was indeed too much. He was no longer the kind, honest, considerate, and patient mistress she knew before.

"Fuck, come here, fat man!"

When Zhao Wuji saw Xiao Wu's refusal, he couldn't force her, so he could only put his last hope on Ma Hongjun.

If even he refuses, it can only be him.

No!

Ma Hongjun could not be allowed to refuse.

He must be allowed to execute.

"Huh?"

"Teacher Zhao, I don't want to, I'm shy!"

Ma Hongjun knew this would happen and immediately expressed his resistance.

“It’s okay if you don’t want to.”

"Your first kiss is long gone, why are you pretending?"

"If you don't agree, I'll beat you up!"

Zhao Wuji glared angrily and gave Ma Hongjun a death order that could not be disobeyed.

Just when Ma Hongjun was about to compromise under the pressure of Zhao Wuji, the frightened Dai Mubai stood up and said, "Teacher Zhao, this matter happened because of me, so I should do it."

Zhao Wuji was deeply relieved to see that Dai Mubai had woken up and knew how to make amends.

Dai Mubai's ability to stand up now shows that he still has a conscience and a sense of responsibility.

"Okay, here you go!"

"Don't let me and Dean down."

"If people make mistakes, it's okay, but they must know that they can correct their mistakes."

Zhao Wuji handed the recovery sausage to Dai Mubai and patted his shoulder solemnly.

"Well, thank you, Teacher Zhao!"

Dai Mubai nodded, walked up to Tang San, chewed up the recovery sausage, and fed it to Tang San himself.

Under the influence of the restored sausage, the edema on Tang San's body disappeared at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Ning Fengzhi and Sword Douluo were slightly shocked when they saw this scene.

Everyone knows that the effect of soul skills is obviously related to the quality of the martial soul.

Oscar's first soul skill has such good effects, which shows how high the quality of his martial soul is.

In order to learn more detailed information, Ning Fengzhi asked with a soft smile: "Oscar, how old are you now? What is your soul power level?"

When Oscar heard the question, he touched his head in embarrassment and replied: "Sect Master Hui Ning, I am fourteen years old, and my soul power level is only twenty-nine. Compared with everyone else, I am indeed a bit slow."

Boom!

When Ning Fengzhi and Sword Douluo heard this, there was a roar in their minds.

A fourteen-year-old food-based soul master, his soul power level has reached level 29.

What a terrifying talent this is.

In their subconscious minds, if a food-type soul master can raise his soul power level to level 20 before the age of fifteen, he is considered a genius.

And the qualifications shown by Oscar are already a peerless genius, a monster among monsters.

"Sect Master Ning, Senior Jian, you don't know."

"Actually, Xiao Ao is the first food-based soul master in the history of Douluo Continent with full tenth level of innate soul power."

"Similarly, he is also the most promising super genius in the history of Douluo Continent to become a Titled Douluo of the Food Department."

Flanders introduced Oscar's situation to Ning Fengzhi, his eyes filled with pride.

"Hiss..."

Ning Fengzhi and Sword Douluo took a deep breath when they heard this.

I have never heard of a food-based soul master with a tenth level of innate soul power.
